title: CLO 2024 Academic Month: The Synergy of Digital Technology and Teaching - Discussion on the Construction of the Fashion Digital Art Creative Practice Workshop
description: CLO Academic Month 2024 Review! Teacher Yang Xuemei from Huizhou University introduced the construction of the Digital Art and Creative Practice Studio for Fashion at Huizhou University—aimed at guiding students to learn independently, it has gradually formed a positive cycle where students give back to teaching after starting their own businesses post-graduation. Based on CLO digital garment technology and combined with experiences from industry, education, learning, and research, various books and apps developed through innovation have proven effective in talent cultivation during the teaching process.

summary: ```markdown # CLO 2024 Academic Month: The Synergy of Digital Technology and Teaching ## Introduction Good evening, teachers, colleagues, and experts. I am Yang Xue Mei, a teacher at Huizhou Academy. Tonight, I will discuss the role of digital technology in the construction process of our workshop. ## Overview of the Fashion Digital Art Creative Workshop First of all, I would like to mention that our Fashion Digital Art Creative Time Workshop was established in 2009. It is based at Huizhou Academy, affiliated with Xuzhi Guangdong Fashion Academy. This workshop serves as a practical innovation platform that integrates fashion, digitalization, teaching, research, and education into one cohesive unit. Our teaching team is recognized as a provincial teaching team. ### Workshop Structure When we built the workshop, it was designed according to the professional direction of the clothing product process. Each direction has two teachers, supplemented by three teaching consultants, creating a team of 24 members. Among them, eight are business professionals, contributing to our impressive turnover of 6 billion yuan, with Professor Fu accounting for nearly 50% of that. ### Achievements and Recognition In 2018, our workshop became a key platform construction unit in Guangdong Province. In 2020, we received the Laomo and Craftsman Talent Innovation Workshop award, followed by the Laomo and Craftsman Innovation Workshop award of Guangdong Province in 2021. Notably, with 76% of our teaching staff being female, I have applied for a female staff innovation workshop in Guangdong Province and Huizhou City. Additionally, our Fashion Digital Art and Creative Practice Workshop was established in 2018 and won the second prize in Guangdong Province's first competition last year. ## Social Training Initiatives Our workshop also emphasizes social training, exemplified by our Laomo workshop activities. Despite the restrictions imposed by the pandemic, we have successfully hosted 38 events, serving over 2,000 people. Our platform has significantly contributed to application development in digital technology. ### Virtual Systems Development We have developed 10 virtual systems, including the **Fashion, Fabric, Pattern, Creative, and Appliance Virtual Formatting Experiment**. This system was recommended by the Guangdong Provincial Education Hall as a national first-class formatting course earlier this year. It has become a competitive test system for comprehensive training and skill assessment for college students nationwide, utilized by over 50 colleges and thousands of students. It was also recognized as one of the top test systems in the country in 2022. ## Teaching Reforms and Media Recognition Our teaching reforms have garnered attention from various media outlets, including Tencent News and Southern Urban News. The Huizhou Academy has promoted education cooperation with new energy initiatives. We officially began our direction of fashion design and engineering internal clothes professionalization in 2021, building on a foundation laid in 2008. We have seen significant growth, establishing ourselves as a leading institution in the field. ## Integration of Digital Technology in Education Digital technology has been seamlessly integrated into our entire clothing education system, which encompasses teachers, students, courses, and environments. This integration allows for a comprehensive teaching and learning experience, enabling students to explore their interests within a supportive environment. ### Textbook Innovation We have developed a series of 10 textbooks tailored to various industry directions. These textbooks incorporate augmented reality (AR) codes, allowing students to access additional information via an app system. This approach transforms traditional paper textbooks into dynamic, three-dimensional learning resources. ### Knowledge Chain Creation The formation of a knowledge chain is crucial for our curriculum. Since we initiated this course in 2011, we have connected our knowledge chain with the industrial chain, developing an innovative teaching theory model that emphasizes experiential learning. ## Virtual Experimentation and Student Engagement Our virtual systems facilitate rich experimentation, allowing students to engage with materials from various historical eras to design internal clothing products. This hands-on approach bridges the gap between art and technology, enabling students to quickly translate theoretical knowledge into practical application. ### Scientific Research and Technological Advancement In 2021, we conducted scientific research on our results, leading to provincial-level approval for our initiatives. Our school features a virtual exhibition system for student works and an internal clothing virtual museum, enhancing the educational experience. ## Student Outcomes and Entrepreneurial Opportunities The data indicates a positive trend among high school graduates in 2023, with 57.6% pursuing relevant fields. However, it is essential to focus on creating a virtual platform that allows students to explore their interests and develop their professional knowledge. Our teaching approach emphasizes collaboration and group learning, enabling students to find their passions. ### Integrating Education and Entrepreneurship Since 2011, we have built an industrialized education team that promotes group cooperation and cross-disciplinary learning. Students are encouraged to engage in entrepreneurial projects, with many forming their own companies while still in school. This model fosters a closed-loop learning system, allowing students to apply their skills in real-world contexts. ## Conclusion In summary, our workshop's journey since 2011 has achieved significant milestones in integrating digital technology into education. The collaboration between teaching, students, and enterprises has created a robust framework for fostering creativity and professional development. I appreciate your attention and look forward to further discussions on these initiatives. ```
